messages.author: f31345e547589d21
messages.subject: Rtmp growing infinitely
parts:
Hi. 

I have a workstation HP Z 620 and a laptop dell precision 3581, both with : 
Ubuntu 22.04
R 4.5.1
INLA_24.12.11

The ubuntu versions are customized by my institute and are not the same for desktop and laptop. Everything is fine with the laptop : it models hundreds of time series like a charm. But when I try to do the same thing with my desktop, the /tmp directory fills up (Rtmp in fact) and on my last attempt, I had over 98 GB in /tmp (115 GB of hard disk).

I don't have any reproducible code and my question is: has anyone ever encountered this kind of problem?

For now, I'm tempted to install a Debian instead of this custom ubuntu.

Thanks in advance
Sincerely
DS

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Rtmp growing infinitely
parts:
Haven’t seen this before.  After u quit R session you can safely cleanup Rtmp at /tmp
 
 
You can install the most recent inla version using
 
 
inla.update(testing=T)
 
And then install Ubuntu22 binaries with
 
 
inla.binary.install()
 
And chose the 22 one

-- 
Håvard Rue 
hr...@r-inla.org
